title: Sforza chancery letter in cipher, cart. 1597 (DECODE R5464)

steps.what: Fetched all 174 cart. 1597 records from DECODE (115 key sheets, 59 ciphertexts).
Built a sign reader (deskew, line strips, connected components, dot attachment, Ward clustering) after the CTTS reader failed on these scans.
CTTS homophonic solver run headless on the sign tokens with period Italian, Latin and other corpora.
Shuffled-token runs and simulated Italian ciphers with 0, 8 and 15% sign noise: real/shuffled score ratio 1.65 for Italian against Latin 1.38, Spanish 1.36, French 1.32.
Word-guided key refinement, token pair rules and a hand correction pass on P1 and P2 lines 1-3; dictionary-word coverage rose 10.9% to 24.2%.
Only short stretches build Italian words (dele letere, gravisima, tornare, desiderio); no sentence-level reading.

Outside check of issue 492 (prabal-rje): their own keys for R5464 and R5465, found from the ciphertext alone on our sign tokens, were re-applied to the tokens; the shown-letter shares (86.4% of 3,249 signs; 68.0% of 5,828 signs) reproduce, and their R5464 letters equal our refined key's letters on 89.7% of the shown signs (they state 86.6% of all signs). The sense-reading by two blind language models (65-70% of shown letters for R5464) was not re-run; it is the contributor's figure and is not counted here.

PR 494 (prabal-rje): their keys and decodes for R5463, R5464 and R5465, in our sign labels, were re-applied to our tokens with own scripts. Shown shares reproduce (R5463 1,070 of 1,372 = 78.0%; R5464 2,808 of 3,249 = 86.4%; R5465 3,961 of 5,828 = 68.0%); R5464 shown letters equal our refined key's on 89.7% and their main key equals it on 86.6% of signs. For R5463 their key equals our refined key on only 48.8% of signs (55.7% of shown signs); their decode builds Italian words by eye where ours does not. The blind-reader sense figures, simulation accuracies and rival-hill figures are the contributor's and were not re-run. Not a reading by the read bar.

outcome.method_basis: Language is Italian (controls), but the sign reader and 60-homophone key give only 24% dictionary-word coverage; no sentences build.
outcome.notes: Image resolution (15-25 px signs) is the limit; the unsent request to ASMi asks for 400 dpi images of leaves 158-159 and 164-165.

prior.where: No decipherment found in DECODE, Tomokiyo or the literature checked.

human: Project-level: the user set the goals, approved downloads (CTTS) and asked for the hand pass.
